payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test asserted only that each gate_result fact's `at` matched a generic ISO-timestamp regex, never its actual value, so a1/a2/a7's gate results carrying their start time instead of their close time would still pass. Added exact `at` assertions for every attempt group in the test (via a new `_iso` helper), checking closed attempts (a1, a2, a7) against their recorded `ended_at` and open attempts (a3-a6) against their `started_at`. Verified the probe (`at = attempt["started_at"]`) now fails.
